name: Shoko AniList Scrobble
overview: Scrobble Jellyfin-originated episode watches from Shoko to AniList. Not a history sync.

releases.release_notes:
## Shoko AniList Scrobble 1.0.0

Portable `any` plugin archive. Add this repository to Shoko with:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crowquillx/shoko-anilist-scrobble/metadata/manifest.json`

The persistent metadata feed is updated on the `metadata` branch after this release.

### Changes

- cebcf46 Add an AniList scrobble plugin for daily Shoko.
### Artifacts

- `Shoko.AniListScrobble-1.0.0-any.zip`, plugin archive
- `manifest.json`, Shoko repository manifest
